column1: This file presents data that supplement CBO’s January 2025 report The Budget and Economic Outlook: 2025 to 2035.

This file provides the spending projections underlying The Budget and Economic Outlook: 2025 to 2035. The data are provided at the budget account level (by Treasury Identification Number, or TID), with discretionary and mandatory spending separated; budget authority and outlays are presented in millions of dollars. TIDs and their supplementary identifying information (including titles, agencies, and bureaus) largely come from external sources.
